prompt: Write a ~300-word professional workplace message about: announcing a change to the meeting schedule. Plain prose.
text:
Subject: Update to Meeting Schedule Effective Immediately

Dear Colleagues,

As part of our ongoing efforts to optimize productivity and efficiency, we are implementing changes to our regular meeting schedule. These adjustments will take effect immediately.

Key modifications include:

* The morning team meetings, previously held at 9:00 AM, will now convene at 10:30 AM.
* The weekly project status updates will be condensed into bi-weekly sessions, scheduled for every other Wednesday at 2:00 PM.
* Bi-monthly strategy sessions with senior leadership will continue to take place on the second and fourth Fridays of each month at 1:00 PM.

These changes aim to streamline our meeting schedule while maintaining essential communication channels. Each adjustment has been carefully considered to minimize disruptions and promote a more focused work environment.

To ensure a smooth transition, please note the following:

* Meetings scheduled before the changes take effect will proceed as planned.
* All relevant team members have been notified of the updated meeting times via email or direct notification.
* A comprehensive calendar update will be provided shortly, reflecting the new meeting schedule.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding these adjustments, please do not hesitate to reach out. We encourage your feedback and are committed to adapting this change as needed to meet our evolving needs.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation in implementing these updates.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Position]
